title: Oracle initialization predicate
statement: Given an oracle $O:	ext{Fin}(4)	o	ext{List}(	ext{Bool})	o	ext{Bool}$, an input bit string $x$, and a natural number $s$, define the initialization predicate on a natural number $u$ to hold exactly when the oracle's query at index $1$, on the nested self-delimiting encoding of $x$, the binary expansion of $u$, and the binary expansion of $s$, returns true.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle from four indices to Boolean-valued bit-string queries
